items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams. He’ll rest the ailing ankle with hopes of healing long-term; no IR discussion.
items.why: Lingering ankle issues (both sides historically), DNP all week; coach wants rest for long-term health.
items.implication: Misses Week 6; monitor for multi-week absence. Volume shifts to backups.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Cardinals RBs behind him.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury. Second straight miss; Tyler Huntley to start again.
items.why: Left ankle sprain from Week 4; no practice this week despite rehab progress hopes.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens offense less explosive. Jackson targets Week 7.
items.opportunity: Huntley streaming upside; Ravens skill players slightly downgraded but still viable.

items.text: Jets once again have ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) for Sunday’s game vs. the Patriots.
items.implication: Continued absence; Jets backfield remains committee/backup heavy.

items.text: Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for week 6. However, I LIKE Tanner McKee.
items.why: Ruled out (blood clot/calf context); McKee starts.
items.implication: Eagles offense changes; McKee streaming option. Impacts Saquon/Smith/Goedert.
items.opportunity: McKee as QB streamer; potential role shifts for Eagles skill players.

items.text: Caleb Williams officially is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game after another full practice.
items.why: Returning from injury; full practices but official Q designation.
items.implication: Likely to play but monitor final status; Bears offense hinges on him.
items.opportunity: If out, backup QB and adjusted WR/RB usage.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed with high-ankle sprain but surprised he could practice; feels pretty good. Chance practicing more for next Thursday (TNF) availability than this week.
items.why: High-ankle but practiced; NE has TNF next week so caution possible.
items.implication: Monitor status; potential limited or held.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Stevenson or backups rise.

items.text: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. has no injury designation for Sunday’s game and is expected to start vs. the Bears.
items.implication: Full go; stabilizes Falcons offense including London/Bijan.
items.opportunity: Positive for ATL pass catchers and RBs.

items.text: Drake London vs. CHI is a Love (WR6); bankable usage in solid spot.
items.why: Usage you can bank on; positive matchup themes.

items.text: George Kittle vs. WSH is a Love (TE3); Commanders defense nightmare for TEs.
items.why: Soft matchup vs WSH; TE-friendly defense.

items.text: Kyren Williams vs. ARI Love (RB5); elite recent usage and leaking run defense.
items.why: Elite usage lately; ARI run defense leaks.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle vs. SEA Hate (WR28); ugly matchup and QB situation concerns.
items.why: Seattle tough for WRs; shaky QB context. Also Q-return from shoulder TNF.

items.text: LOVE love love Mike Evans against my Commanders secondary this week. Evans is my WR4 for Week 6.
items.why: Commanders defense is a buffet for pass catchers; strong matchup.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone upside vs weak secondary.

items.text: Javonte Williams @ GB Love (RB8); volume and goal-line role key.
items.why: Volume + goal-line work vs leaking defense.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson vs. NYJ Love (RB9); volume vs soft run D.
items.why: Volume and matchup vs leaking Jets run defense.
